card.name: Words just before 'summary' or 'abstract'
card.fires_on: Small words or word starts right before an expected 'summary', 'synopsis', 'abstract' or 'overview', such as 'an', 'by', 'in a' (nutshell), or 'Plot'. It fires where the next word is likely a summary-type noun.

modes.label: Linking word before summary noun
modes.description: An article or preposition that leads into a summary-type word like article, overview, or abstract.

modes.label: Start of a summary heading
modes.description: The first part of a heading or word that becomes synopsis or plot summary.
